confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain because licensing and venue markups vary, and beer is priced as a bottled domestic serving since draft is uncommon. Accommodation spread is wide between medina riads and Gueliz hotels (hotel_3star_2p plausibly about 75-110). July is hot and typically quieter for city tourism, so rates reflect typical July levels. The FX figure came from RBA-domain search results, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Moroccan urban tourist pricing. Food and cafe anchors are benchmarked loosely to other Moroccan tourist centres such as Fez and Essaouira; accommodation tiers reflect Marrakech's own medina and Gueliz stock. Cocktail is set at roughly double the beer anchor and wine glass somewhat above beer, using the local price relationship because direct knowledge of licensed-venue drink prices is weaker.
